statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-118899 makes an nginx worker process loop forever while it reads a request body over TLS 1.3 on a listen socket with the ssl parameter, so the worker stops serving connections. nginx.org lists 1.13.0 to 1.31.8 as vulnerable and fixes it in 1.30.7 and 1.31.9 (https://nginx.org/en/security_advisories.html, https://my.f5.com/manage/s/article/K000163930); the 1.30.7 fix is https://github.com/nginx/nginx/commit/1b723277aa556ba4c6e40cc8f0f0b465e29c0a13 with its HTTP/3 counterpart https://github.com/nginx/nginx/commit/d1640655f46c5a2d32fefc2c818583f203e47536. Every nginx-mainline package published for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI repository (1.28.2-r0 and 1.29.5-r0 to 1.29.8-r7 on x86_64 and aarch64, and 1.29.4-r0 on aarch64) contains no files and only depends on the nginx package of the same version, so it carries no nginx code of its own. That nginx package is affected and has no fixed build for Alpine 3.23. Pending: whether this owner should be recorded as not containing the component, or should follow the affected nginx owner it depends on.

CVE-2026-118899 makes an nginx worker process loop forever while it reads a request body over TLS 1.3 on a listen socket with the ssl parameter, so the worker stops serving connections. nginx.org lists 1.13.0 to 1.31.8 as vulnerable and fixes it in 1.30.7 and 1.31.9 (https://nginx.org/en/security_advisories.html, https://my.f5.com/manage/s/article/K000163930); the 1.30.7 fix is https://github.com/nginx/nginx/commit/1b723277aa556ba4c6e40cc8f0f0b465e29c0a13 with its HTTP/3 counterpart https://github.com/nginx/nginx/commit/d1640655f46c5a2d32fefc2c818583f203e47536. For Alpine 3.24, 1.31.9-r5 is the first and only nginx-mainline build of 1.31.9 in the DHI repository; its nginx binary reports nginx/1.31.9 on x86_64 and aarch64. The builds 1.31.2-r2 to 1.31.8-r5 ship nginx from upstream releases in the vulnerable range with no backport of the fix, and the earlier 1.29.8-r0, 1.29.8-r1, 1.31.2-r0 and 1.31.2-r1 packages contain no files and depend on the vulnerable nginx package of the same version. The 1.31.2 to 1.31.8 builds sort above the 1.30.7 stable fix but are still vulnerable, so the range ends at 1.31.9-r5 rather than at 1.30.7.

Every nginx build published for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI repository (1.28.0-r8 to 1.28.3-r9 and 1.29.5-r0 to 1.29.8-r7 on x86_64 and aarch64, plus 1.28.1-r0 and 1.29.4-r0 on aarch64) is an upstream release in the vulnerable range. The newest of them, 1.28.3-r9 and 1.29.8-r7, were built on 2026-08-03, before nginx released the fix on 2026-11-18. The 1.28.3 builds, including 1.28.3-r9, take the Alpine 3.23 nginx recipe at revisions up to its 1.28.3-r7, which predates Alpine's backport of this fix in 1.28.3-r8, so none of them carries it. No fixed build is published for this owner yet.

Every nginx build published for Alpine 3.24 in the DHI repository (1.28.3-r1, 1.29.8-r0, 1.29.8-r1, 1.30.3-r1, 1.30.3-r2, 1.31.2-r0 and 1.31.2-r1 on x86_64 and aarch64, plus 1.28.3-r0 on aarch64) is an upstream release in the vulnerable range and carries no backport of the fix; all of them were built on or before 2026-06-23, before nginx released the fix on 2026-11-18. The 1.31.2 builds sort above the 1.30.7 stable fix but are still vulnerable. No fixed build is published for this owner yet.

CVE-2026-118899 makes an nginx worker process loop forever while it reads a request body over TLS 1.3 on a listen socket with the ssl parameter, so the worker stops serving connections. nginx.org lists 1.13.0 to 1.31.8 as vulnerable and fixes it in 1.30.7 and 1.31.9 (https://nginx.org/en/security_advisories.html, https://my.f5.com/manage/s/article/K000163930); the 1.30.7 fix is https://github.com/nginx/nginx/commit/1b723277aa556ba4c6e40cc8f0f0b465e29c0a13 with its HTTP/3 counterpart https://github.com/nginx/nginx/commit/d1640655f46c5a2d32fefc2c818583f203e47536. Debian fixes it for trixie in 1.26.3-3+deb13u11 (DSA-6642-1, https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-118899) and lists 1.26.3-3+deb13u10 and earlier trixie revisions as vulnerable. The fixed version in this range is the DHI rebuild of 1.26.3-3+deb13u11, the first nginx build in the DHI Debian repository made from that revision; the earlier builds there are rebuilds of 1.26.3-3+deb13u9 and 1.26.3-3+deb13u10 and lack the fix. We checked the nginx and nginx-dbgsym packages of this build and of the 1.26.3-3+deb13u10 rebuild on amd64 and arm64, each against its index checksum. The Debian changelog shipped in the fixed build lists the CVE-2026-118899 backport from 1.30.7, 'handle NGX_AGAIN explicitly while reading HTTP request bodies'. In /usr/sbin/nginx, read through the debug symbols with the matching build ID, ngx_http_do_read_client_request_body grows from 0x7e9 to 0x80c bytes on amd64 and from 0x6fc to 0x728 bytes on arm64 and gains comparisons with the NGX_AGAIN value (-2), while ngx_http_read_client_request_body and main keep the same size.
